summary.prose: Building this amendment means wrapping the one existing codex retry-targetable call in readOnlySessionOnce with a second, bounded attempt: when codex's bootstrap rejects a disable override for one server, that server is dropped from the list and the call is retried exactly once more. The daemon's own judge session, which exercises this exact path, is the acceptance proof that the fix actually restores a working build pipeline on a machine like this one.

tasks.title: Add a bounded one-retry recovery to readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch when a disabled server is unexcludable
tasks.summary: Wrap the existing runCodex call (and its existing CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError catch) in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch with a bounded retry: on catching CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError(name) from the first attempt, filter name out of the servers list, rebuild codexReadOnlySessionArgs from the filtered list, and call runCodex exactly one more time with the same recomputed remaining budget. A second failure of any kind (including another CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError) re-throws unchanged -- never more than one retry. A non-matching first-attempt failure is unaffected and re-throws immediately as today.
acceptanceChecks: readOnlySessionOnce retries once with the offending server removed, and succeeds, when a safe server remains after filtering
readOnlySessionOnce retries once with no non-insrc disable overrides at all, and succeeds, when the unsafe server was the only non-insrc entry
readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming the SECOND server when the retry also fails with a bootstrap-rejection match -- never more than one retry
readOnlySessionOnce re-throws the original, unmodified error (no retry attempted) when the first attempt's failure does not match the bootstrap-rejection pattern
the retry uses the recomputed remaining budget, not a fresh one, and still throws ReadOnlySessionTimeoutError if combined attempts exhaust it

insrc_build_step validate's own judge session (which resolves to codex for the 'build' role tier on this machine) completes successfully end to end, where it previously failed with verdict-session-failed
